basic_details.job_title: TCI Foundation Senior Accountant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online

important_dates.nature of appointment validity: Till 31 March 2027 (subject to continuation of grant)

application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee.

qualification.details: Computer proficiency with commonly used softwares/ packages like MS Word, Excel, Power Point & Web surfing. Knowledge and proficiency in finance related softwares and packages such as Tally, PFMS, GeM, and integrated accounting softwares. Good communication (oral and written) and presentation skills, analytical and interpersonal abilities. Ability to work in a multi-disciplinary team environment.

salary_details.details: During official travels if required, the consultant will receive a fixed per diem allowance for boarding/lodging expenses as per the travel policy of the organization.

how_to_apply: Visit the official application portal using the link provided below.
Fill out the application form with all required details.
Upload necessary documents as requested by the system.
Submit the application form before the last date of 17 October 2026.
important_instructions: Given the large volume of applications received, the organisation is unable to respond to all applicants and responses are limited to those who are shortlisted. Merely fulfilling the eligibility and applying for the position does not entitle the candidate to be called for interview. No TA/DA will be paid to attend the interview in person. The advertised position can be cancelled or varied as per the discretion of the employer. Either party can terminate the contract by giving one month’s notice in writing.

content_sections.heading: TCI Foundation Senior Accountant Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Senior Accountant position.

content_sections.heading: TCI Foundation Senior Accountant Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Computer proficiency with commonly used softwares/ packages like MS Word, Excel, Power Point & Web surfing. Knowledge and proficiency in finance related softwares and packages such as Tally, PFMS, GeM, and integrated accounting softwares. Good communication (oral and written) and presentation skills, analytical and interpersonal abilities. Ability to work in a multi-disciplinary team environment.

rows.qualification_required: Post-graduate in commerce preferably MBA (Finance), with minimum 3 years’ experience in accounting analysis (preferably in health sector), budgeting, financial software including Tally, PFMS and reporting systems. OR Graduate in commerce with good academic record; and minimum 5 years of post-qualification work experience in accounting and finance.

content_sections.heading: TCI Foundation Senior Accountant Salary
content_sections.text: During official travels if required, the consultant will receive a fixed per diem allowance for boarding/lodging expenses as per the travel policy of the organization.

faq.question: Q1. What is the TCI Foundation Senior Accountant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a contractual fixed-term consultancy recruitment by TCI Foundation for one Senior Accountant post under the Intensified Malaria Elimination Project-3 (IMEP-3) in Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for TCI Foundation Senior Accountant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Senior Accountant post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for TCI Foundation Senior Accountant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply is 17 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for TCI Foundation Senior Accountant?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Post-graduate degree in commerce preferably MBA (Finance) with 3 years of experience, OR a Graduate in commerce with 5 years of post-qualification work experience in accounting and finance.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for TCI Foundation Senior Accountant?
faq.answer: The consultancy fee band is upto ₹ 35,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee for TCI Foundation Senior Accountant?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected for TCI Foundation Senior Accountant?
faq.answer: Selection is carried out through advertisement followed by a walk-in-written test or interview for shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the job location for TCI Foundation Senior Accountant?
faq.answer: The place of posting is at the National Centre for Vector Borne Diseases Control, Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Sham Nath Marg, Civil Lines, Delhi.
